FIFA 98 - Road to World Cup.name: FIFA: Road to World Cup 98
FIFA 98 - Road to World Cup.summary: SNES and Sega Genesis port of FIFA: Road to World Cup 98.

Irena - Genesis Metal Fury.name: Irena: Genesis Metal Fury
Irena - Genesis Metal Fury.summary: Irena Genesis Metal Fury is a brand new shoot'em up designed for the SEGA Genesis / Mega Drive which is inspired by classic games of the 90’s such as Thunder Force III / IV, Aero Blaster, Super Shinobi II and Contra Hard Corps.

Rampart.name: Rampart
Rampart.summary: Rampart is a game combining strategy and artillery action. Build your castle from Tetris-style pieces, place your cannons, bombard the enemy, try to repair, do it all over again. The original arcade release has a single-player and a two-player mode; later revisions incorporate three-player gameplay.

Soldiers of Fortune.name: Soldiers of Fortune
Soldiers of Fortune.summary: Soldiers of Fortune (Chaos Engine in the EU) is a run-and-gun overhead shooter. Sixteen levels (in four groups of four) await the players in the game. The basic gameplay is in an open air setting, with bridges across rivers and other features in the maps. The visuals are in a 'metallic and blue' style. There are six characters available in the game, each with different strengths and weaknesses, and different starting prices.

Tecmo Super NBA Basketball.name: Tecmo Super NBA Basketball
Tecmo Super NBA Basketball.summary: Tecmo Super NBA features real teams (all 27 contemporary teams) and a roster of real players (over 320). One or two players can compete in regular, reduced, or short seasons, or play an exhibition game. Though primarily horizontal scrolling, digitized speech and cinemas, along with a free throw point of view, add drama to the proceedings. Besides the expected elements of basketball (substitutions, penalties, steals and blocks, time-outs, overtime), Super NBA gives you the chance to call offensive plays and to program win/loss records. Has a battery to back-up season play.
